questions.stem: 雖然暖身只要幾分鐘，跳過它卻是青少年運動受傷的主因。
questions.answer: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skipping it is the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers.
accepted_answers: Even though a warm-up only takes a few minutes, skipping it is the main reason why teenagers get hurt in sports.
Though it takes just a few minutes to warm up, skipping warm-ups is the major cause of teenagers' sports injuries.

questions.stem: 運動前暖身很重要，因為還沒熱開的肌肉常常僵硬到很容易受傷。
questions.answer: It is important to warm up before exercising, because cold muscles are often so stiff that they get hurt easily.
accepted_answers: It is important to warm up before exercise because muscles that are still cold are often so stiff that they get injured easily.
It is important to warm up before working out, since cold muscles are usually so stiff that they can easily get hurt.

1.explanation_zh: 「雖然…卻…」英文只用一個連接詞：Although／Even though + 子句，後面的主要子句不再加 but。「跳過它卻是…的主因」主詞是動詞片語「跳過它」，英文改成動名詞 skipping it，後面接單數動詞 is。「運動受傷」當名詞用 sports injuries（injure 是動詞）。
1.strategy_zh: 中文主詞是「做某件事」時，英文用 V-ing（或 To + VR）當主詞，動詞用單數。
hints: 切成四段：雖然暖身只要幾分鐘／跳過它卻是／青少年運動受傷的／主因
標的詞彙：warm up（暖身，L1）、minute（分鐘，L1）、skip（跳過，L3）、cause（原因，L2）、injury（受傷，L3）、teenager（青少年，L1）
句型框架：Although + S + V, V-ing … + is + the main cause of …

2.explanation_zh: 「運動前暖身很重要」主詞是動詞片語，英文用虛主詞：It is important to warm up before exercising（也可以寫 Warming up before exercising is important）。「僵硬到很容易受傷」是「so + 形容詞 + that + 子句」表結果，so 不能換成 very；「還沒熱開的肌肉」可以說 cold muscles 或 muscles that are not warmed up。
2.strategy_zh: 「做某事很＋形容詞」想 It is + adj. + to VR；「…到（結果）」想 so + adj. + that。
hints: 切成四段：運動前暖身很重要／因為還沒熱開的肌肉／常常僵硬到／很容易受傷
標的詞彙：important（重要的，L1）、warm up（暖身，L1）、exercise（運動，L1）、muscle（肌肉，L3）、stiff（僵硬的，L3）、hurt（受傷，L1）、easily（容易地，L1）
句型框架：It is + adj. + to VR …, because + S + be + so + adj. + that + S + V

references: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skipping it is the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers.
Even though a warm-up only takes a few minutes, skipping it is the main reason why teenagers get hurt in sports.
Though it takes just a few minutes to warm up, skipping warm-ups is the major cause of teenagers' sports injuries.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步子句（Although／Even though + S + V）

accepted: Although warming up takes only a few minutes
Even though a warm-up only takes a few minutes
Though it takes just a few minutes to warm up
Although warming up only takes a few minutes
Although it only takes a few minutes to warm up
Even though warming up takes only a few minutes
Although a warm-up takes just a few minutes

common_errors.wrong: Although warm up takes only a few minutes
common_errors.right: Although warming up takes only a few minutes
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「暖身」在這裡當主詞，要用動名詞 warming up（或名詞 a warm-up）。

common_errors.wrong: Although warming up takes only a few minute
common_errors.right: Although warming up takes only a few minutes
common_errors.explanation_zh: a few 後面接複數名詞 minutes。
動詞片語不能直接當主詞，要改成動名詞 skipping it。
although 和 but 不能同時用；「雖然…卻…」英文只保留一個連接詞。

accepted: why teenagers get hurt in sports
why teenagers get injured in sports
of teenagers getting hurt in sports

common_errors.explanation_zh: injure 是動詞，「受傷」當名詞要用 injury（複數 injuries）。
「運動受傷」當名詞用 sports injuries；hurt 很少當這種名詞用。

common_errors.wrong: the main reason of sports injuries
common_errors.right: the main reason for sports injuries
common_errors.explanation_zh: reason 後面接 for 或 why 子句，不接 of。
main 本身就是「主要的」，不再加 most。

traps.literal_error: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skip it is the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文主詞是動詞片語「跳過它」，照字面寫 skip it is 不合文法；要改成動名詞 skipping it。

traps.literal_error: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skipping it is the main cause of teenagers' sports injure.
traps.explanation_zh: 「受傷」在這裡是名詞，要用 injury／injuries，injure 是動詞。

1.restructuring_zh: 「跳過它」是動詞片語當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 skipping it；「青少年運動受傷的主因」也要改成 the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers，把修飾語移到後面。

references: It is important to warm up before exercising, because cold muscles are often so stiff that they get hurt easily.
It is important to warm up before exercise because muscles that are still cold are often so stiff that they get injured easily.
It is important to warm up before working out, since cold muscles are usually so stiff that they can easily get hurt.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It＋形容詞＋不定詞

patterns.frame: S + be + so + adj. + that + S + V

accepted: It is important to warm up before exercising
It is important to warm up before exercise
It is important to warm up before working out
It is important to warm up before you exercise
It is important to warm up before doing exercise
Warming up before exercising is important
It is very important to warm up before exercising

common_errors.wrong: Warm up before exercising is very important
common_errors.right: It is very important to warm up before exercising
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語不能直接當主詞；用虛主詞 It is important to …，或改成動名詞 Warming up …。

common_errors.wrong: It is important warm up before exercising
common_errors.right: It is important to warm up before exercising
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞，不能漏掉 to。

accepted: because muscles that are still cold
because muscles that are not warmed up
because muscles that have not been warmed up

common_errors.right: because muscles that are not warmed up
common_errors.explanation_zh: 長的修飾語不放在名詞前面，改用 that 子句，或直接說 cold muscles。

common_errors.wrong: because the muscles not warm up
common_errors.right: because muscles that are not warmed up
common_errors.explanation_zh: 少了關係代名詞和 be 動詞；肌肉是「被暖開」，寫成 that are not warmed up。
「…到（結果）」用 so + 形容詞 + that，不用 very。
such 後面接名詞；只有形容詞時用 so。

common_errors.wrong: they are easily to get hurt
common_errors.explanation_zh: easily 是副詞，直接修飾 get hurt；be easily to … 不合文法。
肌肉是「受傷」，要用 get hurt 或 be injured；they easily hurt 會變成「容易疼痛／傷害別人」。

traps.literal_error: Warm up before exercising is very important, because cold muscles are often so stiff that they get hurt easily.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文主詞是動詞片語，照字面寫 Warm up … is 不合文法；用虛主詞 It is important to warm up …。

traps.literal_error: It is important to warm up before exercising, because cold muscles are often very stiff that they get hurt easily.
traps.explanation_zh: 表示結果的「…到…」要用 so + 形容詞 + that，very 不能和 that 子句搭配。

2.restructuring_zh: 「運動前暖身很重要」主詞是動詞片語，英文用虛主詞 It 開頭，把真正的主詞 to warm up before exercising 移到後面。

1.translation: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skipping it is the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers.
1.explanation_zh: 「雖然…卻…」英文只用 Although，不再加 but；「暖身只要幾分鐘」以動名詞 warming up 當主詞，搭配 take + 時間；「跳過它」也用動名詞 skipping it 當主詞；「青少年運動受傷的主因」譯 the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers。

2.translation: It is important to warm up before exercising because muscles that have not been warmed up are often so stiff that they get injured easily.
2.explanation_zh: 「運動前暖身很重要」用虛主詞 It is important to V；「因為」用 because 副詞子句；「還沒熱開的肌肉」用 that 關係子句（現在完成被動）；「僵硬到很容易受傷」用 so + adj. + that 表程度結果。

1.translation: Although warming up takes only a few minutes, skipping it is the main cause of sports injuries among teenagers.
1.explanation_zh: 「雖然……卻」只能用一個連接詞，所以用 Although 而不加 but；動名詞 warming up、skipping 當主詞；「主因」用 the main cause of。

2.translation: It is important to warm up before exercising because muscles that have not warmed up are often so stiff that they are easily injured.
2.explanation_zh: 「運動前暖身很重要」用虛主詞 It is important to；「僵硬到很容易受傷」用 so…that… 結果子句；「還沒熱開的肌肉」用 that 關係子句修飾 muscles。
